column1: ## provenance  captured   = real output, produced by running the command in the
##                          scratch C, Rust, Go, Java, Python, Ruby, Perl, PHP and
##                          JS projects, a scratch 64 MiB ext4 image, a scratch
##                          redis-server on a private port and a scratch JVM made
##                          for the purpose; inputs 001-065). Everything ran with
##                          scrubbing; Java tools ran with the container's
##                          command with NO_COLOR=1 TERM=dumb. Scratch files under
##                          /tmp keep their /tmp names. No git command was run to
##             reproduced = faithful reproduction of the tool's documented
##                          output format, written by hand because the tool or
##                          platform is not available in the container (Windows,
##                          macOS, network gear, storage arrays and hypervisors,
##                          databases, z/OS, CICS, OpenVMS, Solaris, AIX, HP-UX,
##                          IBM HMC, HPC schedulers, bioinformatics, VoIP, mail;
##                          inputs 101-142). Data values are invented; addresses
##                          use the RFC 5737 / RFC 3849 documentation ranges and
## category    the axis the write-up breaks results down by (round-3 names).
## family      the shape family the write-up aggregates by (round-3 names).
## shape       free-text description of the layout.
## Chosen for shape diversity and novelty BEFORE any input was run through
## provost; no input was chosen, edited or dropped after its parse was seen.
## The sha256 of every frozen input is in SHA256SUMS (same directory).
